description:
intent=i042 snapshot=s13 branch=tasklet-napi-softirq-lock status=complete
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/ath/carl9170/main.c:263 conclusion=Follow up: trace carl9170 TX/BA processing (tx.c, mac.c) for a softirq-context acquisition of tid_info->lock to pair with the plain process-context acquisition in carl9170_flush_ba (main.c:263).
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath5k/base.c:1126 conclusion=Follow up: enumerate every plain spin_lock acquirer of ah->txbuflock/ah->block/ah->rxbuflock in ath5k and check each tasklet body (rxtq/txtq/ani_tasklet/beacontq) for the same lock taken in softirq, to decide whether a BH-enabled process holder pairs with a tasklet spinner.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/htc_drv_txrx.c:1131 conclusion=Follow up: read ath9k_rx_tasklet/ath9k_tx_failed_tasklet/ath9k_wmi_event_tasklet bodies and classify each plain spin_lock (wmi->event_lock, hif_dev tx/rx locks, cc_lock) as process or softirq side to test the BH-disable invariant.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/ralink/rt2x00/rt2x00queue.c:671 conclusion=Follow up: open the rt2x00 interrupt tasklet bodies (rt2400pci/rt2500pci/rt2800mmio/rt61pci tasklet macros and the rt2x00dev.c:1184 expansion) and pair their locks against the plain queue->tx_lock/irqmask_lock process-context sites.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:3822 conclusion=Follow up: reassign mwl8k stream_lock to the xmit-softirq-lock branch (workqueue holder vs NET_TX mwl8k_txq_xmit), and only check here whether any mwl8k tasklet body takes stream_lock in softirq context.
coverage_gap=Only about 30 of the roughly 357 tasklet_init files in the tree were triaged; drivers/dma (27 files), drivers/mmc/host (12), drivers/crypto (12), drivers/scsi, sound/pci, drivers/media, drivers/s390 and drivers/hv tasklet bodies were never read for a plain process-context partner lock.
coverage_gap=NAPI poll functions were not enumerated in s13 this session; only tasklet callbacks were deep-read, so NAPI-poll-vs-process-context plain spin_lock pairs (the NET_RX half of branch3) remain unexamined except where incidentally touched.
coverage_gap=Remaining staging drivers with tasklets (rtl8188eu, rtl8723bs, rtl8192e/u, rtl8712, wlan-ng, mt7621-dma, ks7010 itself) and net/ core tasklet users (mac80211, smc, ppp) were grepped for presence but their lock pairings were not classified.
coverage_gap=Lock correlation was textual, by lock-expression base name per file; locks reached through differently named pointers, container_of aliases, or per-queue lock arrays between softirq and process sites could not be matched automatically.
